text:
morgan: Quick proposal for v2 route cutover and deprecation windows — want to get buy-in before we lock dates. TL;DR: opt-in rollout, 3-month canary, 3-month soft deprecation (warn-only), 2-month hard cut. Thoughts? :calendar:

andrew: Sounds reasonable. Can you call out what 'soft deprecation' looks like in practice? header warning? telemetry?

morgan: Soft-deprecation = responses include `warning` header + dashboard catches (per-customer events). Not blocking, but we surface migration blockers to CS and PMs. Hard cut = 429/410 on v1.

raj: A few runtime notes: v2 changes function-calling semantics and structured output envelope. We can implement a compatibility mode in the serving runtime that rewrites v1->v2 envelopes for most simple cases, but it has perf overhead and won't cover custom toolcall signatures. Suggestion: auto-mapping for common fields + opt-in header: `X-Redwood-Compat: v1`

carmen: We'll need an SDK shim and migration doc. I can draft a checklist if engineering provides a clear list of breaking changes and recommended code patches. Also want examples for tool-calls, embeddings dim change, and responses for rerank.

raj: Breaking changes off the top of my head (short):
- tool/function calling: `tool.name` vs `tool_id` and arg envelope changed
- response envelope renamed (v1 `choices` -> v2 `items`)
- streaming chunk format slightly different (chunk metadata added)
- embeddings: default normalization toggled, dims unchanged but ordering changed for some models
- headers: model routing header changed from `X-Model` -> `X-Redwood-Model`
- default sampling seed behavior adjusted

sasha: Enterprise ask: we need 9mo notice for customers on dedicated/private. Also require a managed migration offer for top-10 accounts. They won't accept surprise tokenization diffs.

legal-team: Quick flag — confirm that no data residency or retention changes are introduced by v2. If anything changes we need contract/customer notice templates.

devex-bot: New migration doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/migrations/v1-to-v2 (draft). Please add SDK snippets and a one-page runbook. :spiral_note_pad: 

andrew: Acceptance criteria for GA v2 (proposal):
- Compatibility suite: pass v1->v2 compatibility tests for top-10 customer call patterns (chat, toolcall, embeddings, rerank)
- SDKs: official shims in JS/Python + migration guide + examples
- Rollout playbook: canary policy, auto-fallback to v1 for unhandled errors, per-customer console toggle
- Observability: deprecation telemetry and alerts in Console + CS inbox integration

morgan: Proposed timeline (based on today):
- Week 0 (opt-in): announce docs + SDK shim, enable `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` header for customers to opt-in to compat-rewrites
- Week 8 (canary): enable default v2 for 10% of requests for self-serve customers, enable per-customer canary for enterprise
- Week 20 (soft-deprecate): start returning `Deprecation` header on v1 routes and surface in Console; CS outreach begins
- Week 32 (hard cut): disable v1 for non-enterprise customers who haven't migrated; enterprise schedule individually (but target completion by +40w)

morgan: Migration snippet (example):
```
# opt into compat rewrite
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n     -H "X-Redwood-Compat: v1" \n     https://api.redwood.com/v2/chat
```

raj: Implementation note: compat-rewrite will look at request body and map `messages`->`inputs`, `choices`->`items`, and will attempt to rewrite old toolcall payloads into new `function_calls`. We'll document edge cases where manual change required.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled: `v2-compat/rewrite` -> staging at 2039123900 :rocket:

liv-cs: I'll assemble customer migration priority list and flag the ones needing hands-on migration. Will add to the migration doc as a table with contact owners.

andrew: One last ask — let's add a quick rollback mechanism: if compat-rewrite error rate > 1% for a customer, automatically flip them back to v1 routing and create a ticket.

morgan: Agreed. I'll update the playbook with rollback thresholds and runbook steps. Thanks all — I'll push an initial schedule + task assignments to the migration doc and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
